Cortico World 长期记忆：一张卡片表 + 4 个工具 + 一段静态提示词，附状态、日程、主动开口与本地记忆地图。

author: lutsing

zh.description:
一张卡片表、四个工具、一段 419 字的静态提示词。改口不覆盖：旧卡退休、新卡记下接替了谁，召回时不会再同时看到作废的和改后的那条。附带状态、日程、主动开口，以及一个本地记忆地图（图谱 / 时间线 / 维护面板）。

QQ 交流群：745879632

en.description:
One card table, four tools and a 419-character static prompt. Corrections don't overwrite: the old card is retired and the new one records what it supersedes, so a retracted plan never comes back alongside the revised one. Ships mood/energy state, today's plan, speaking first, and a local memory map with graph, timeline and a maintenance panel.

QQ group: 745879632
